desc: [UPSTREAM DRAFT ONLY — CJ posts when reporting resumes] Package the multi-core fail-stop fault into a maintainer-ready report after ticket 217 pins the storage-free artifact. Include the dependency-free reproducer, exact Image/DTB/initramfs hashes, logical-CPU to MPIDR/MIDR map, fresh-boot run matrix, full uninstrumented oops, and the completed 207/208 negative result showing that smp_mb and an irrelevant read merely perturb the race. State the bounded fail-stop evidence without claiming page-cache safety, and do not propose the refuted copy_highpage barrier as a fix. Deliver report text plus an attachment/hash manifest; never post externally.
